svg.title: Queen of the Thrones of Flame: Queen of Wands · Water of Fire (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Water of Fire; rules from 20° Pisces to 20° Aries, as Book T counts. Its ring: number 6 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/grammars/1795881243487-qehtwvcw3y8.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
